{{Quote|Come on, General, let's get you fed and watered. You won't be fit for much without some decent ''skraan'' inside you.|Dec, to Etain Tur-Mukan|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Dec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in command of [[Vevut Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Order 66" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Dec was trained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] sergeant [[Rav Bralor]]. The commando and their [[Squad/Legends|squad]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]<ref name="Order 66" /> and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Vevut Squad&mdash;together with fellow commando [[unit]]s [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and their commanding [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]&mdash;went to the Republic [[Station Nerrif]] to be reassigned. After exiting their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], Dec led Tur-Mukan to the mess and encouraged her to eat something. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] noted that Dec and their squadmates behaved like sons trying to please their mother.<ref name="Order 66" /> Like all Fett clones,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Dec stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dec appeared in [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Order 66" />
